太极：山海流转
生成工具：内置 image_gen；透明背景；原始像素与透明通道保留。
用途：1.3 二：极性，页首主插画。

最终绘图提示词：
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE exceptionally beautiful epic Taiji / yin-yang emblem as a standalone editorial hero illustration for an elegant Chinese philosophy website. SQUARE composition. A monumental, perfectly circular yin-yang disk fills about 83% of the image. Preserve immediately recognizable CLASSIC TAIJI GEOMETRY: two balanced interlocking comma-shaped lobes divided by a single graceful S curve, and exactly TWO small circular eyes, a pale eye embedded in the dark lobe and a dark eye embedded in the pale lobe. The geometry must read instantly at small size. The dark lobe is deep charcoal ink with restrained moss-green mountain strata and flowing ink currents; the light lobe is pale warm ivory mist and luminous cloud-sea. Both move around one shared center in a powerful balanced spiral. Add exquisite fine aged-gold seams and delicate topographic strata within the disk, with sparse elegant ink and mist wisps just outside its perimeter. Feel like an immense ancient landscape and cosmic order condensed into one symbol: vast, majestic, elemental, contemplative, authoritative, epic through scale, depth, texture and restrained light. Refined East Asian ink-wash mixed with mineral pigments and subtle sculptural relief; avoid a shiny metallic medallion or plastic 3D logo. Website palette: charcoal #232925, muted moss #59664f, warm ivory #efeee8, antique gold #c6aa7c. The outside surrounding the disk must be genuinely TRANSPARENT, including between the wisps; no rectangular paper background, no dark background. The pale lobe itself stays opaque warm ivory. No words, letters, calligraphy, seals, bagua trigrams, runes, extra symbols, extra eyes, animals, dragons, human figures, neon, rainbow, stars or busy galaxy background. The silhouette and two eyes must remain clear and quiet. Finish with restrained museum-quality detail.
